prompt: Use an instructor-provided unseen disposable local alerting case, or a learner-created and held-back unseen disposable case, materially different from LES-0030 guided fixtures and answered scenarios. It must include an ambiguous user journey or denominator, at least two alert windows or state transitions, one zero/no-data/missing-series/evaluator-error ambiguity, one grouping/deduplication/inhibition/silence or receiver-delivery defect, one misleading dashboard, one low-traffic or synthetic-probe limitation, and one safe recovery decision. After the independence gate, do not open ASM-0073, ASM-0074, the lesson's complete-answer or product-company sections, or generated solutions. Produce a sanitized evidence package that traces signal to human decision, reconciles alert and notification populations, tests at least five ranked hypotheses, computes quality/capacity where supported, redesigns the dashboard and runbook, proves authorized containment and cleanup, and gives a five-minute interview explanation with at least twelve explicit proof limits.
deliverables: Completed independence, authorization, environment, help, accessibility and sanitization gate before investigation
User-operation, good/total event, SLI/SLO, coverage, freshness, no-data, severity, ownership and response-time contracts
Text architecture from user event and probe through telemetry, evaluator, alert state, routing, suppression, receiver, acknowledgement, escalation and human action
Raw sanitized evaluation, state, fingerprint, grouping, receiver and dashboard evidence with exact time, scope and proof limits
At least five ranked falsifiable hypotheses with predicted, confirming and rejecting evidence
Correct zero/no-data/missing-series/error classification and tested rule-state timing
Alert-instance, duplicate, inhibited, silenced, grouped, delivered, acknowledged, escalated and resolved population reconciliation
Quality, burn-rate or capacity calculations only where the unseen data supports them, with assumptions and uncertainty
Task-oriented dashboard and runbook redesign with owner, immediate action, abort, rollback and missing-evidence behavior
Low-traffic and synthetic-probe coverage analysis without mixing synthetic success into real-user truth
Authorized containment plus separate user, telemetry, evaluator, receiver, human-response and cleanup proof
Five-minute interview explanation and at least twelve technically precise non-claims
evidenceRequirements: The case was unseen and materially different from published guided and answered scenarios
The learner was authorized only for the disposable local target and recorded all help received
No secrets, personal names, employer names, customer data, raw identifiers, private paths or real notification endpoints are submitted
Every claim links to sanitized raw evidence or a declared calculation, or is labeled inference, hypothesis or unknown
User health, telemetry health, evaluator state, notification delivery, acknowledgement and resolution are distinguished
Zero, no data, missing series, stale, partial, query error and healthy results are not collapsed
A silence or stopped notification is never presented as user or monitoring recovery
No production, shared, employer, online cloud, email, SMS, paging or chat system is modified or contacted
Cleanup proves exact absence of every process, port, file, queue, container, network or other resource the case was allowed to create
A qualified reviewer confirms no answer leakage, unsafe action, fabricated evidence or mastery inflation

rubric.observableEvidence: Unseen case, declared help, authorized disposable scope, sanitized raw evidence and no answer leakage or fabrication.

rubric.criterion: User journey, SLI and objective model
rubric.observableEvidence: Good/total events, scope, SLO, clocks, coverage, freshness and synthetic boundaries are precise.
Signal-to-human path names owners and reconciles instances, duplicates, suppression, delivery, acknowledgement and resolution.
At least five hypotheses are ranked, falsifiable and tested at discriminating boundaries.
Timing and zero/no-data/missing-series/stale/partial/error states are correctly classified and tested.
Supported calculations use matched populations, units, assumptions, uncertainty and precise limits.
Grouping, dedupe, inhibition, silence, owner, action, runbook, expiry, escalation and fatigue are handled safely.
Dashboard supports real tasks; access, secrets, templates, silences, audit and sensitive data are controlled.
Canary, abort, rollback, separate recovery planes, observation window and exact final absence are proved.
The interview response is clear and at least twelve proof limits are technically specific.
